testcases.title: TC-GEO-663-002 - Category: KPI row shows exactly 4 cards without SOV and layout reflows cleanly

steps.title: Given a user is authenticated and navigates to a Category view
When the Performance KPI row renders
Then it shows the same 4 KPI cards: Visibility, Avg Position, AI Choice, Sentiment — and no Share of Voice card
And the KPI row layout reflows cleanly for 4 cards with no broken grid or empty cell

testcases.title: TC-GEO-663-004 - Category: Brand Rankings table has no SoV% column

steps.title: Given a user is authenticated and navigates to a Category view
When the Brand Rankings table renders
Then the table columns are exactly: Rank, Brand, Visibility%, Avg Position, LLM Choice%
And there is no SoV% column header and no SoV% cell in any parent or variant row

testcases.title: TC-GEO-664-002 - SOV dedicated card renders below KPI row on Category view

steps.title: Given a user is authenticated and navigates to a Category view with data available
Then a full-width "Share of Voice" card is visible directly below the KPI card row
And the card displays the title "Share of Voice" and the subtitle "By brand, your brand is highlighted"
